Around [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] created a '''vast collection of documents''' kept for historical interest. It was established in hopes of preserving [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] knowledge and memories from the ravages of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. It contained data on [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] history dating back the foundation of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
Twenty-one [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[25 ABY/Legends|after]] the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|destruction]] of the [[Death Star II/Legends|second]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], after a brief period of unstable and uncertain peace, faced one of the biggest threat in galactic history: the attack of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], a species of [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] invaders. A pan-[[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong War|conflict]] ensued, and it became necessary to collect the archives lest they were lost forever under the rubble of the war.<ref name="SWFF1" />

A huge centralized data pool was created to include all the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Holocron/Legends|Holocrons]] and all existing files, documents and plans relating to the New Republic, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. The New Republic centralized archives had the pretension of completeness and was known to be accessible by [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]].<ref name="SWFF1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The New Republic Centralized archives were mentioned at the back of the galaxy map provided with the [[The Official Star Wars Fact File 1|first issue]] of ''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File]]''. The existence of such a collection gave in-universe perspective to the ''Official Star Wars Fact File''.
